author: CC
prose: The user (Akien) said, mid-session on akiendell, verbatim: "you keep spinning up python windows, you have at least 4 open now". The orchestrator asked for a ticket so Cairn's own long-lived spawns (ground_loop, bus serve) are windowless on Windows (CREATE_NO_WINDOW / DETACHED_PROCESS in creationflags, or pythonw), after finding every spawn site, and for a red-first proof; the build waits until Akien says the windows can run. Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: of 4 python processes (ground_loop launcher 25696 + python3.exe 29212; bus serve launcher 1648 + python.exe 16184) only the two children, 29212 and 16184, own a console window (16184 has conhost 16980); the launchers (venv Scripts\python.exe) have none. tools/bus_client/remote.py:270 already passes DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NO_WINDOW for the bus, yet its child shows a window. Hypothesis (unmeasured): the venv launcher starts the real interpreter as a child without those flags, so the child allocates a console.
